applicabilityBasis.summary: reUSD is a senior NAV-based reinsurance capital token. Its purchase agreement characterizes it as derivative tranched debt under BVI law, restricts noteholder rights to registered eligible holders and does not require the issuer to maintain redemption liquidity. Current product documentation describes repayment in the deposit asset at the accrued price. These facts do not establish the GENIUS fixed-monetary-value obligation or a U.S. securities/deposit exclusion; applicability remains uncertain pending qualified token-specific legal analysis.

genius.notes: Reviewed under D17 on 2026-10-01: the former non-payment-token exemption based on yield, NAV and non-U.S. access restrictions is withdrawn; the proposed excluded-security replacement is also unsupported by a qualified U.S. legal determination. Resilience (BVI) Ltd remains the token issuer under the purchase agreement; the Cayman foundation/operator and SPC roles are separate. Applicability, authorization, pathway, foreign-exception and DASP posture remain unresolved, not findings of authorization or wrongdoing. The no-public-action-found observation is retained as historical evidence from the 2026-07-14 review, not a newly exhaustive regulator search.
